text_en: Thus says the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their robes, to open doors before him— and the gates shall not be closed:
text_cn: 上主这样对他的受傅者居鲁士说： ──我牵着他的右手，使他蹂躏他面前的列国，解除列王的腰带；我在他前开启城门，使门户不再关闭──

text_en: I will go before you and level the mountains, I will break in pieces the doors of bronze and cut through the bars of iron,
text_cn: “我要走在你前面，把崎岖的路修平；我要把铜门打破，将铁闩击碎，

text_en: I will give you the treasures of darkness and riches hidden in secret places, so that you may know that it is I, the Lord , the God of Israel, who call you by your name.
text_cn: 把隐藏的钱财和秘密的宝物赐给你，为叫你知道：是我上主，以色列的天主，提着你的名召叫了你。

text_en: For the sake of my servant Jacob, and Israel my chosen, I call you by your name, I surname you, though you do not know me.
text_cn: 为了我的仆人雅各伯和我所拣选的以色列的缘故，我提着你的名召叫了你，给你起了这个称号，纵然你还不认识我。

text_en: I am the Lord , and there is no other; besides me there is no god. I arm you, though you do not know me,
text_cn: 我是上主，再没有另一位；除我以外，没有别的神；虽然你还不认识我，我却武装了你，

text_en: so that they may know, from the rising of the sun and from the west, that there is no one besides me; I am the Lord , and there is no other.
text_cn: 为叫从日出到日落之地的人都知道：除我之外，再没有另一位。我是上主，再没有另一位；

text_en: I form light and create darkness, I make weal and create woe; I the Lord do all these things.
text_cn: 是我造了光明，造了黑暗；造了幸福，降了灾祸：是我上主造成了这一切。”

text_en: Shower, O heavens, from above, and let the skies rain down righteousness; let the earth open, that salvation may spring up, and let it cause righteousness to sprout up also; I the Lord have created it.
text_cn: 诸天，请由上滴下甘露，望云彩降下仁义，愿大地裂开生出救恩，愿正义一同出生！我上主创造了这事。

text_en: Woe to you who strive with your Maker, earthen vessels with the potter! Does the clay say to the one who fashions it, “What are you making”? or “Your work has no handles”?
text_cn: 祸哉，那与自己的制造者争辩的！瓦器岂能与抟（tuán）泥者争辩？陶器岂能对陶工说：“你做的是什么啊！”或说：“你手制的不精美！”

text_en: Woe to anyone who says to a father, “What are you begetting? ” or to a woman, “With what are you in labor? ”
text_cn: 祸哉！那向父亲说：“你为什么生子？”或向母亲说：“你为什么生育？”的人！

text_en: Thus says the Lord , the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: Will you question me about my children, or command me concerning the work of my hands?
text_cn: 以色列的圣者、安排将来的上主这样说：“关于我子女的事，你们要质问我吗？或者对我手中的工作，你们有所吩咐吗！

text_en: I made the earth, and created humankind upon it; it was my hands that stretched out the heavens, and I commanded all their host.
text_cn: 是我造了大地，又造了地上的人；是我亲手展开了诸天，布置了天上的星辰；

text_en: I have aroused Cyrus in righteousness, and I will make all his paths straight; he shall build my city and set my exiles free, not for price or reward, says the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 是我由于仁义唤起了他；我要修平他的道路，他要修建我的城池，遣回我的俘虏，而不索取赎金，也不要求报酬”。这是万军上主说的。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : The wealth of Egypt and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, tall of stature, shall come over to you and be yours, they shall follow you; they shall come over in chains and bow down to you. They will make supplication to you, saying, “God is with you alone, and there is no other; there is no god besides him. ”
text_cn: 上主这样说：“埃及的工人，雇士的商人，以及色巴的巨人，都要过来，归属于你；他们都要带着锁链追随你后；并俯伏在你面前，恳求你说：惟独你这里有天主，以外没有别的神明。”

text_en: Truly, you are a God who hides himself, O God of Israel, the Savior.
text_cn: 以色列的天主，救主！你真是隐密的天主。

text_en: All of them are put to shame and confounded, the makers of idols go in confusion together.
text_cn: 制造偶像的人必蒙羞受辱，一同归于羞惭。

text_en: But Israel is saved by the Lord with everlasting salvation; you shall not be put to shame or confounded to all eternity.
text_cn: 但以色列必因上主而得救，获享永远的救恩：你们不会蒙羞受辱，直到永远。

text_en: For thus says the Lord , who created the heavens (he is God! ), who formed the earth and made it (he established it; he did not create it a chaos, he formed it to be inhabited! ): I am the Lord , and there is no other.
text_cn: 因为那创造诸天的上主──只有他是天主，是他创造、形成和奠定了大地：他并非创造了一团混沌（dùn），而是为使人居住才造了它──他这样说：“我是上主，没有另一位。

text_en: I did not speak in secret, in a land of darkness; I did not say to the offspring of Jacob, “Seek me in chaos. ” I the Lord speak the truth, I declare what is right.
text_cn: 我没有在隐秘处或黑暗之地说过话，我没有给雅各伯的子孙说过：你们徒然寻求了我！我上主，只说真实，惟讲公理。

text_en: Assemble yourselves and come together, draw near, you survivors of the nations! They have no knowledge— those who carry about their wooden idols, and keep on praying to a god that cannot save.
text_cn: 列国的余民！你们一起集合起来，一同前来吧！凡抬过偶像，敬拜过不能施救的神祇的，真是无知！

text_en: Declare and present your case; let them take counsel together! Who told this long ago? Who declared it of old? Was it not I, the Lord ? There is no other god besides me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is no one besides me.
text_cn: 请你们陈述，请你们证明，也让你们一同商量商量：是谁从古时就叫人听到这事呢？是谁早已宣布了呢？不是我，上主吗！的确，除我以外，没有别的神！除我以外，再没有一个仁义的神和救主。

text_en: Turn to me and be saved, all the ends of the earth! For I am God, and there is no other.
text_cn: 大地四极的人！你们归依我，必能得救，因为只有我是天主，再没有另一个。

text_en: By myself I have sworn, from my mouth has gone forth in righteousness a word that shall not return: “To me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear. ”
text_cn: 我指着我自己起誓：真理一出我口，那话决不返回；人人都将向我屈膝，众舌都要指着我起誓。

text_en: Only in the Lord , it shall be said of me, are righteousness and strength; all who were incensed against him shall come to him and be ashamed.
text_cn: 人都要说：唯有在上主前有仁义和力量。凡向他发怒的，必要含羞地归依他。

text_en: In the Lord all the offspring of Israel shall triumph and glory.
text_cn: 以色列所有的后裔，必要因上主获胜夸耀。”
